daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最明顯的是$NVDA，4個帳號明確看多，相關帖文13則。@Beth_Kindig 估算 Nvidia 的 ACIE 部門營收增速高於超大規模雲端服務商（138.5%對101.2%），保守估計五至六個季度內可能追上。原帖 @Jason 表示今日買入一些 $GOOG 與 $NVDA，形容兩家公司有卓越領導層與產品。原帖 @StockSavvyShay 則提到 $NVDA 據報正洽談為 Nscale 的 460MW 數據中心提供逾50億美元信用擔保，該中心有450億美元 $ANT 算力合約支持。原帖 防禦輪動方面，@KeithMcCullough 說 Hedgeye 將最高配置分給醫療保健 $XLV，社群亦重新加倉必需消費 $XLP。

共同看淡

$RDDT有10個帳號看淡，是今日共識最集中的空方，相關帖文24則。@ripster47 直說$RDDT是重大失望，日活躍用戶未達預期，已在約135美元平掉多頭，並形容為容易交易的100 PSYCH空頭設置。原帖 @StockSavvyShay 把$RDDT列入10月成長股重挫名單（約-41%）。原帖 $INTC有9個帳號看淡，帖文48則：@TrendSpider 指出自昨日收盤以來已跌約三成，為公司55年歷史上最嚴重跌幅；@garyblack00 指PC需求展望疲軟與指引問題加速科技股資金外流。原帖 原帖 另有多方提到$NOW一日抹去三個月漲幅並跌破200日均線。

分歧

$AMZN是今日被提及最多的代號之一，5個帳號看多、2個看淡，帖文66則。@munster_gene 認為AWS增長前景構成新敘事，今日約佔銷售25%，五年後或至少佔收入五成；@ChrisCamillo 說昨晚積極加倉$AMZN，同時在其他地方去槓桿，認為不宜在短期過度操作；@saxena_puru 則指出財報後股價大跌，但公司並未放緩AI建設，Alphabet維持1950-2050億美元2026年資本支出指引。原帖 原帖 原帖 $SNDK同樣分裂（3多4淡）：有帳號引述Sandisk CEO指AI基礎設施客戶低估NAND需求，同時盤後反應名單裡仍有人把它與科技股殺跌並提。

其他值得留意

@RedDogT3 指出至少$TSLA提供以分層系統來導航的方式，387-388美元持有以增加及管理。原帖 @OptionsMike 關注$SPY 748.80點位。無人機／國防主題上，@ripster47 與@TrendSpider 提到$ONDS等名稱回溫。整體上，財報後個股分化大於指數單一敘事。

共識

過去一週共同看好最集中的是$SOFI，7個帳號看多，相關帖文27則。@Jake__Wujastyk 指出月線蠟燭有相當恢復；@RedDogT3 說財報後形態少見，策略以跳空缺口樞紐位做多波段；@Mr_Derivatives 為$SOFI升至17.25美元喝采。原帖 原帖 原帖 $SKHY方面，@ThetaWarrior 稱業績前掃單者今早獲利了結，總利潤約406萬美元。原帖 半導體ETF亦有買盤討論。

共同看淡

共同看淡首位是$RDDT（10個帳號），與每日窗一致：日活躍用戶遜預期與成長股回撤主導論述。@ripster47 再次提到約135美元平多頭。原帖 $BA仍有4個帳號看淡。另有$RBLX與高收益債$HYG進入共同看淡名單。

分歧

$SPY本週8多11淡，帖文128則；$MU與$NVDA則偏多但仍有空方聲音（各約10多3淡），有帳號提及$MU未來18個月或見1700美元目標。@APompliano 引述觀點認為空頭將再次被證明錯誤，華爾街兩年前預期自由現金流6億，現在是320億。原帖 $TSLA12多1淡，@RedDogT3 關注387-388分層管理區間。

其他值得留意

$MA與$LMT進入共同看好前段；記憶體與半導體ETF買盤，與財報後網路／半導體殺跌並存，是本週主旋律。

過去一個月共同看好最集中的是$SOFI（8個帳號），金融科技與財報後形態討論延續至月度框架。@Jake__Wujastyk 指出月線蠟燭有相當恢復；@RedDogT3 以跳空缺口樞紐位做多波段。原帖 $MA與$NKE各有6個帳號看多；$RSP、$LMT、$UNH亦進入共同看好前列，反映輪動與防禦／等權主題。

$CRWV分歧最極端：4個帳號看多、24個看淡，帖文224則。@APompliano 引述觀點認為即使$CRWV，債務相對訂單積壓仍可控，每1美元資本開支在科技業有5至6倍乘數效應；同時大量帳號把新雲與AI基礎設施回撤視為風險焦點。原帖 $SPY為12多15淡；$TSLA則22多3淡，偏多但仍非單向共識。

daily.brief: Over the past ~27 hours, 58 accounts posted 320 related items. Common bearish is led by $RDDT (10 accounts) and $INTC (9 accounts). Common bullish is led by $NVDA (4 accounts). Biggest splits are on $AMZN (5 long / 2 short) and $SNDK (3/4) after earnings.
daily.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish today is $NVDA, with 4 accounts long and 13 related posts. @Beth_Kindig estimates Nvidia ACIE revenue growth may outpace hyperscalers (138.5% vs 101.2%) and could catch up in about five to six quarters. post @Jason said he bought some $GOOG and $NVDA, citing strong leadership and products. post @StockSavvyShay noted reports that $NVDA is in talks to provide over $5B of credit support for a 460MW Nscale data center backed by a $45B $ANT compute contract. post On rotation, @KeithMcCullough said Hedgeye put its highest equity allocation into healthcare $XLV, with the community also re-adding staples $XLP.

Common Bearish

$RDDT has 10 bearish accounts, the densest common short today, with 24 related posts. @ripster47 called it a major disappointment after daily active users missed, saying longs were covered around $135 and framing a 100 PSYCH short setup. post @StockSavvyShay listed $RDDT among October growth-stock drawdowns (about -41%). post $INTC has 9 bearish accounts and 48 posts: @TrendSpider said it was down about 30% from the prior close, the worst drop in the company's 55-year history; @garyblack00 pointed to soft PC demand outlook and guidance as accelerating tech outflows. post post Several also flagged $NOW wiping out three months of gains and breaking the 200-day average.

Divergence

$AMZN is among the most-mentioned names, with 5 bullish and 2 bearish accounts and 66 posts. @munster_gene argued AWS growth supports a new narrative, with AWS about 25% of sales today and maybe at least half of revenue in five years; @ChrisCamillo said he aggressively added $AMZN while de-levering elsewhere, viewing the market as too dangerous for short-term over-trading; @saxena_puru noted the post-print drop but said AI buildout is not slowing, with Alphabet maintaining $195-205B 2026 capex guidance. post post post $SNDK is similarly split (3 long / 4 short): some cite the Sandisk CEO saying AI infrastructure customers underestimated NAND demand, while others still list it among post-earnings tech declines.

Other Notable

@RedDogT3 noted that at least $TSLA offers a layered system to navigate, holding $387-$388 to add and manage. post @OptionsMike is watching the $SPY 748.80 level. On the drone/defense theme, @ripster47 and @TrendSpider mentioned names like $ONDS warming up. Overall, post-earnings stock differentiation exceeds any single index narrative.

weekly.full:
Consensus

The most concentrated common bullish over the past week is $SOFI, with 7 accounts long and 27 related posts. @Jake__Wujastyk noted a solid recovery in the monthly candle; @RedDogT3 said the post-earnings pattern is rare, with a strategy of trading the gap pivot for swings; @Mr_Derivatives cheered $SOFI rising to $17.25. post post post On $SKHY, @ThetaWarrior said pre-earnings sweep buyers took profit this morning for about $4.06M total. post Semiconductor ETF buying is also discussed.

Common Bearish

Common bearish is led by $RDDT (10 accounts), consistent with the daily window: daily active users missing and growth-stock drawdowns dominate. @ripster47 again mentioned covering longs around $135. post $BA still has 4 bearish accounts. $RBLX and high-yield $HYG also entered the common bearish list.

Divergence

$SPY this week is 8 long / 11 short with 128 posts; $MU and $NVDA lean long but still have short voices (roughly 10/3 each), with accounts mentioning a $MU $1,700 target over the next 18 months. @APompliano cited views that shorts will again be proven wrong, as Wall Street expected $6B free cash flow two years ago versus $320B now. post $TSLA is 12 long / 1 short, with @RedDogT3 watching the $387-388 layered management zone.

Other Notable

$MA and $LMT entered the front of common bullish; memory and semiconductor ETF buying coexisting with post-earnings internet/semiconductor declines is the week's main theme.

monthly.full:
Consensus

The most concentrated common bullish over the past month is $SOFI (8 accounts), with fintech and post-earnings pattern discussion continuing into the monthly frame. @Jake__Wujastyk noted a solid recovery in the monthly candle; @RedDogT3 uses the gap pivot for swings. post $MA and $NKE each have 6 long accounts; $RSP, $LMT, and $UNH also entered the front ranks, reflecting rotation and defensive/equal-weight themes.

Common Bearish

$RDDT with 10 accounts is the top monthly common bearish, aligning with the weekly and daily windows; @ripster47 mentioned covering around $135 and the daily active user issue. post $BA still has 4 bearish accounts. Others include $RBLX, $HYG, and $TMUS.

Divergence

$CRWV has the most extreme split: 4 long / 24 short accounts, 224 posts. @APompliano cited views that even for $CRWV, debt relative to backlog remains manageable, with every $1 of capex having a 5-6x multiplier in tech; meanwhile many accounts treat the new-cloud and AI infrastructure drawdown as a risk focus. post $SPY is 12 long / 15 short; $TSLA is 22 long / 3 short, leaning long but not unidirectional consensus.

Other Notable

In the monthly frame, AI-related names (especially new cloud) show the widest divergence, while consumer finance, payments, and some defensive names more often appear on the common bullish side. Accounts mention a $MU $1,700 target over the next 18 months.
